Cp (kPa) = Cell Pressure

ea = axial strain

	Loose sand M1 (Isotropic consolidation- effective stress 200kPa)
Stage 1-7 Saturation up to 550kpa (mistake mix with consolidation) 
Stage 8 Consolidation -cell pressure up to 800 kPa - effective stress 200kPa. 
Stage 9-14 Shear stage undrained (increase in pore pressure at the beginning, slow down the displacement)
